Scenario fixture: dialog-name-present (role="dialog"/"alertdialog" must have an accessible name)

Each target element has a stable id of the form dialog_case_NN. role="dialog"/"alertdialog" is name-from-author-only per WAI-ARIA: only aria-label, aria-labelledby, and title are valid; heading/body content is NOT a valid name source unless explicitly wired via aria-labelledby.

01 — FAIL: role=dialog, no name at all

This references the dialog below by id.
